subject.fix: Updated CC#4 to strip backticks from $3 (path) AND $4 (sha), trim whitespace, then match. Added exclusion for the self-reference row. Regenerated 54 stale SHAs across m9-01..m9-10 archive-manifests.
subject.gap: CC#4 awk pattern '$4 ~ /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/' failed because the field still had backticks at match time. The CC silently never fired.

findings.summary: CC#4 had a broken awk regex ($4 had backticks at match time) so it never fired. Discovered 54 stale SHAs in m9-01..m9-10 archive-manifests. Fixed awk + regenerated.

subject.fix: Updated CC#5 to match only m9-* rows via '^| m9-'. Now actual=65, declared=65 (was actual=81, declared=65).
subject.gap: CC#5 awk regex was '^| (m6 |m[7-9])' which matched all m6/m7/m8 milestone rows in cycles/index.md (16 extra rows).

findings.summary: CC#5 regex matched all m6/m7/m8 milestone rows, silently off-by-16. Fixed to match only m9-* rows.

subject.fix: Added CC#54 as a sibling of CC#48. Both are invoked by check_vault_drift.sh. Refactored the script to capture bash_exit before || true (which masks non-zero exits under set -e), and use a tmpfile for the CC count handoff between python and bash phases.
subject.gap: The 7 bash CCs (CC#1, #4, #5, #6, #46, #53) had no auto-execution. They were validated manually only, leaving room for silent drift.

findings.summary: CC#48 meta-check only auto-executes python CCs. Added CC#54 (bash sibling meta-check) + refactored check_vault_drift.sh to invoke both.

lens_summary: m9-66 closes 3 drift classes with one focused B-direct cycle. CC#4 silent failure (54 stale SHAs), CC#5 off-by-16, and the no-meta-check-for-bash-CCs gap. Two-commit structure: (1) fix CCs + add CC#54, (2) regenerate 54 stale SHAs.
